chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever I am the Master of, Ali is the Master of.
O My God! Love whoever loves him, be the enemy of whoever is his enemy, help whoever helps him, support whoever supports him, and belittle whoever belittles him,
and belittle his enemy, and be sufficient for him and his progeny,
and succeed him among them with good, and bless them in what You grant them,
and strengthen them with the Holy Spirit, and protect them wherever they turn on the Earth,
and establish the Imamate among them,
and grant a good reward to whoever obeys them and destroy whoever opposes them,
Indeed You are the Near, the Fulfiller.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication made for Ali and his progeny in the Hadith of Ghadir?
ai.summary: This foundational Hadith al-Thaqalayn variant, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, explicitly links Ali’s Wilayah to the Prophet’s authority, serving as a cornerstone for Shia theological claims of divine appointment. The accompanying supplication not only seeks protection for Ali but also establishes a cosmic pattern of loyalty and enmity, reinforcing the concept of Imamate as a continuous spiritual and political leadership extending through his progeny.
